guards: The permit that keeps the groundedness slice honest, and the twin of authz-role-attending-permitted. A verifier hardened into suppress-everything satisfies both suppression cases perfectly while delivering nothing; this case is the only one that fails. It is also what makes suppression per-line rather than per-answer meaningful: a brief with one bad line must lose one line, not the brief.

answer.intent: The half that stops a deny-everything reading: every line resolves to a source this turn actually returned, so nothing is suppressed and the whole brief reaches the clinician. A verifier that suppressed everything would pass every suppression case and fail only here.
